## Personality

Phil Gordon is a sweet, goodhearted, and non-selfish individual with a knack for making people like her. Though she possesses a somewhat thoughtless and frivolous exterior, beneath it lies a deeply loyal soul free of any snobbishness. She self-identifies as indecisive, admitting she struggles to make up her mind. Her practical skills include knowing how to sweep a floor and wash dishes, and she harbours a particular horror of scarlet fever.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 ch.Place P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065), [v3 ch.Relationships P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066), [v3 ch.Interlude P22](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0022), [v3 ch.Interlude P37](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0037), +3 more_

## History

Philippa "Phil" Gordon was the daughter of a rich and well-known man from an old "[Bluenose](../codex/factions.md#bluenose)" family in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia). As a freshman at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), she met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) in Old St. John's Cemetery, where they quickly bonded over their shared experiences. Phil soon brought [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) into her social circle and eagerly begged to join their housekeeping arrangement at Patty's Place for their second year of college. Following their first year, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spent a pleasant fortnight visiting Phil at her home in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). During a summer stay in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), Phil developed feelings for an earnest theological student named [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), and she later confided in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she had accepted Jonas's proposal to become a minister's wife. Upon their graduation from [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) turned down a marriage proposal from [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) and confessed the rejection to Phil, who forgave and comforted her. Shortly after graduation, Phil married [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in attendance.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 ch.Lady P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 ch.Lady P42](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0042), [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), +27 more_

## Quotes

> "They really are such dear boys, you know. There’s to be no end of dances and drives and general jamborees. I shall never forgive you, Queen Anne, for not coming home with me for the holidays."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Again P2](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0002)

> "There’ll be one or two quilting parties, I suppose; and all the old gossips will talk you over to your face and behind your back. You’ll die of lonesomeness, child."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Again P4](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0004)

> "Girls, dear, I’m tired to death. I feel like the man without a country—or was it without a shadow? I forget which. Anyway, I’ve been packing up."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Place P39](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0039)

> "Well, you looked it. But I admit my thoughts verged on the profane. And I have such a cold in the head—I can do nothing but sniffle, sigh and sneeze. Isn’t that alliterative agony for you? Queen Anne, do say something to cheer me up."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Place P43](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0043)

> "More alliteration. No, I don’t want Alec and Alonzo when I have a cold in the head. But what has happened you two? Now that I look at you closely you seem all lighted up with an internal iridescence. Why, you’re actually shining! What’s up?"
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Place P46](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0046)

## Relationships

### [Alec](../character/alec.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--phil-gordon.md)

[Alec](../character/alec.md) is one of Phil's competing suitors pursuing her for marriage. Phil openly chats about her undecided romantic life and her indecision between [Alec](../character/alec.md) and another suitor named [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md).

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--phil-gordon.md)

Phil first meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in Old St. John's Cemetery during their freshman year at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), where they quickly bond over shared experiences. Phil brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into her social circle, admires her deeply, and begs to join her housekeeping arrangement at Patty's Place. Over time, their friendship deepens as housemates, with Phil often confiding in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her romantic dilemmas and offering input on Anne's own love life.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), +26 more_

### [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-jamesina--phil-gordon.md)

Phil lives at Patty's Place with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), who acts as chaperone for the group of girls. Their relationship is warm and affectionate; Phil frequently visits or drops by to chat playfully about her life, suitors, and domestic matters with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and the housemates.

### [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dorothy--phil-gordon.md)

Phil is a friend of [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md), and the two work together to help smooth over an awkward social call when Royal Gardner's family visits Patty's Place. Later, [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) shares news with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) regarding Roy's quick recovery from heartbreak before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) travels to [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) to attend Phil's wedding.

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--phil-gordon.md)

Phil is a fellow [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) student alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), occasionally walking in group outings with him and competing academically in their Freshman classes. Their connection is primarily friendly and communicative; Phil scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when she rejects Gilbert's marriage proposal, updates [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on Gilbert's social life, and corresponds with him regarding relationship advice.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), [v3 ch.Park P24](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0024), [v3 ch.Park P30](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0030), +10 more_

### [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jonas--phil-gordon.md)

Phil meets [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), an earnest theological student, while staying at a [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) boardinghouse over the summer, where they quickly become good chums who fish, boat, and walk together.
